corpus: LongMemEval-S cleaned; all 500 questions; abstention ids retained

protocol.granularity: session; fresh temporary index per question
protocol.turns: all, same loader and mechanical title/summary as #1081
protocol.chunking: source substrings, <=400 cl100k_base tokens and <=4000 UTF-16 chars; <=80-token overlap, whitespace boundaries where possible, surrogate-safe fallback
protocol.metadata: original session title, summary and tags repeated for each chunk; dates/type unchanged; no invented triggers
protocol.lexical: production SearchIndex.recall over every chunk, maximum score per session; collapse before top-50 document cap
protocol.dense: production EmbeddingIndex/embeddinggemma on each chunk; query normalization from production; maximum cosine over ALL chunk vectors per session, not mean
protocol.fusion: production fuseRRF, K=5, dense weight=1.5, arm caps=50 documents, final depth=20
endpoints: vectors/session, raw vector bytes, persisted bytes, backfill time, query latency
protocol.primary: whole_bm25_maxsim R@1 versus matched #1081 hybrid; lexical counterpart separately versus whole_bm25
protocol.inference: descriptive measured comparison; no shipping threshold chosen after results; metadata replication and corpus-frequency changes are part of the lexical arm
not_measured: main gold set and M1 gates
protocol.gate: none for measurement; no production adoption or passed internal gate
protocol.literal_special_tokens: Tokenizer special-token spellings in public source are counted as ordinary text, unchanged.
